abilities.description:
{Ignore Defense}
When attacking, ignores 50% of the defender's Defense skill

{Fear}
Affected unit has a 10% chance to freeze in fear and skip its turn

{Maximum Damage}
This unit always deals the maximum possible damage

{No Retaliation}
Enemies cannot retaliate against this unit's melee attacks

{Unlimited retaliations}
This unit can retaliate against an unlimited number of attacks

{Attack All Around}
This unit attacks all enemies adjacent to the primary target

{Damage Reduction}
Reduces physical damage from both melee and ranged attacks by 30%

{Fire Shield}
Reflects 1% of melee damage back to the attacker

{Additional Attacks}
This unit can attack 1 additional time(s)

{Cast After Attack}
Has a 30% chance to cast Paralyze after it attacks

{Jousting Bonus}
Each hex moved before attacking grants +5% damage

{Death Stare}
Has a 1% chance to instantly kill one living creature

{Flying}
This unit flies and ignores battlefield obstacles while moving
